_comment: Curated corrections on top of scenes.csv (the stage table) and labels.json (short names).
scenes.csv says what the executable holds; this says what a scene actually turns out to be when you boot it.
Every entry here was checked by launching it.
act         which group the scene belongs in, overriding the one implied by the stage id
rank        sort order inside that group; negative sorts above the act's own scenes, positive below
kind        stage-entry | gameplay | cutscene | briefing | start
description one sentence about what you actually see
sameAs      this id starts the same scene as that one; the list folds them into one entry you can pick from
sortAs      sort as if the id were this, for a scene that belongs somewhere the id does not put it
hidden      out of the list unless the 'Known broken' filter is chosen
